what_happened: Job 20261107-120506-2ms5 (code job: fix the flaky main-CI shard 1 test and record red main CI baselines) failed in planning in round 1 of 5, before any code was written. After 2 mechanical revisions the plan still broke Athena's plan rules. One major finding: the demonstration for behavior criterion 5 cites a command the verifier may not run (`cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <job>/evidence`). Five minor findings: plan.rs, run/checks.rs, run/tests.rs, verify.rs and checks.rs are not among the reading's deliverables. No acceptance criteria or checks are listed as unmet or failed. Nothing was delivered.
cause: The planner is not told which commands the verifier may run as demonstrations, and the code checks the rule only after the plan is written. The planner writes the natural demonstration, which is running the CLI on a snapshot. The mechanical repair step (2 revisions) does not fix which commands are allowed, so a defect the code can detect exactly ends the whole job and the planning spend is lost. The same command and the same rule failed an earlier job, and that failure changed nothing for this one.
other_causes: The planner does not compare the files its steps touch with the reading's deliverables, so scope findings pile up as minor items.
The request bundles two separable pieces of work, a flaky-test fix and recording red CI baselines. That spreads the plan over many files and makes the demonstration for the baseline criterion harder.
open_hypotheses: Whether the reading's deliverable list was too narrow, or the plan touched files it did not need. The fields cannot tell which.
Whether the planner was shown the allowed demonstration commands at all, or saw them and ignored them.
contradictions: The earlier case 20261116-042544-t5h1 shows the same failure with the same command. The failure repeated, so the first case did not lead to a protection.
prevention: Run the code's demonstration-command check inside the planner's own revision loop, and show the planner the allowed command list in its brief. Give the mechanical repair step the ability to replace a disallowed demonstration command with an allowed one, such as a test run or a read of a recorded file. Also check the files the plan touches against the reading's deliverables, and either repair the list or flag the mismatch, before the critic runs. Together these end this class of plan-format failure before the critic's last round.
proposed_request: Make Athena's planning stage catch and repair disallowed demonstration commands before the critic runs. (1) Put the list of commands the verifier may run as demonstrations into the planner's brief. (2) Run the existing demonstration-command check after each planner draft. When a plan cites a disallowed command, such as `cargo run -p athena-cli -- status --snapshot <job>/evidence`, the repair step must replace it with an allowed demonstration, for example a named test, rather than only fixing format. (3) Before the critic runs, compare the files named in the plan's steps with the reading's deliverables and report any mismatch as one mechanical finding. Acceptance: a test replays the plan from job 20261107-120506-2ms5 and from job 20261116-041223-m3vc, and each reaches the critic with no disallowed demonstration command. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.
